usage: python PoC-takeaway/build.py            # all assets from committed, authorized results (~10 min: GIFs re-verify physics)

python PoC-takeaway/build.py --refresh-p17  # refuses unless P17_FINAL_MANIFEST.json + UNSEALED exist and the sealed manifest is on origin/main; then fills P17 columns in 03/04 and re-selects all five GIFs from the P17 test by fixed rules
about: Inputs for build.py. Every number in the figures is computed by build.py from the files named here (or quoted from the named report line). P17 results stay PENDING until --refresh-p17 passes its custody checks.

colors.palette_note: Checked with an OKLab distance + Machado CVD simulation script (the dataviz node validator is not installed here): worst normal-vision dE 18.0 (A-C), worst CVD dE 7.9 (A-C, inside the 6-8 band that is legal only with secondary encoding) - every colour is always paired with a text label. B+G is a lighter step of B on purpose (a B variant). Orange is left to the simulator target; green / amber / red are reserved for outcome status.

dataset.labels: runs/p17/data/{train,dev,val,calib,p17train,p17calib}/labels_*.json (protocol P17_EXISTENTIAL_V1; 326 development scenes; committed at a4a15414)

definitions.scenes: each root is an independently generated scene (plan.json 'lineage' = its own key); no base-scene x variant hierarchy is recorded, so that column is NOT RECORDED
definitions.original: certified status of the target action in the unmodified scene: feasible = VERIFIED, infeasible = CERTIFIED_INFEASIBLE / STATIC_INVALID, unknown = anything else (never counted as infeasible)
definitions.generated: catalogue['generated']: every 1-4 move ordered repair the scene-only generator enumerates (before stride sampling)
definitions.tested: len(sequences): repairs physically verified sequence-by-sequence (existential verifier)
definitions.repaired: infeasible-original scenes with >= 1 verified repair sequence (distinct scenes)

dataset.extra_training: P13 constructor scenes used only for B training / validation under an older labelling protocol: 440 train + 74 val (responses-phases/0094 section 2)
missing: base-scene x variant counts: NOT RECORDED in any plan

gifs.protocol: P16 frozen test (sealed then unsealed in P16). A/B/C panels: the arm's recorded choice, re-verified deterministically with the P16 sequence verifier (status must equal the record). D panel: P16 production D (Dp16) plan, regenerated and accepted only if its replay hash equals the recorded Dp16 hash. Robot motion is drawn only from certified arrays.
gifs.p17_rule: --refresh-p17 re-selects all five slots from the unsealed P17 test: first root in plan order matching each contrast (A/B/C: strict task success as in the analysis; D: found + replay CLEAR), preferring roots executed by all four; no match -> PENDING slot.

trace.01_scenes: captions and plans from runs/p17/mechanisms/evidence/{M0,M1,M2,M3,M4,M6,M5,M8_3}.json (positive = VERIFIED + replay CLEAR; red = counterfactual sequences with their recorded status); M5 alternative slot from EXEMPLARS.json M5.instance
trace.02_dataset: all counts computed by build.py from the label files (326 dev scenes) and the two test plan.json files (scene counts only); 440 + 74 P13 scenes quoted from responses-phases/0094 section 2
trace.03_results_B: runs/p16/eval/B_TEST.json per_arm: complete tasks = noop_correct + repair_success over decided_roots (112); no move = noop_correct / feasible (72); repaired = repair_success / infeasible (40). Matches responses-phases/0088 table I.1
trace.03_results_D: runs/p16/eval/D_TEST.json per_guide: success / n (21 common roots of 48); calls_mean.motion_checks. Matches 0088 table II.1
trace.04_ablations: P16 numbers computed from B_TEST / D_TEST at build time; P13 numbers quoted from responses-phases/P13_2D_FACTOR_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION.md (row named in each 'source')
trace.gifs: choices from runs/p16/data/test/sealed_exec_*.json (unsealed in P16, manifest 9389d34); B-type arms re-verified (status must equal record) and D plans regenerated (replay hash must equal the recorded Dp16 hash) before drawing
